title: Coconut Cream Pastry Bites
description: Delicious Chinese-inspired pastry bites filled with a creamy coconut filling. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a bowl, mix coconut cream, low fat cream (if using), and algerian cream until smooth.
Add sugar (if using) and mix well.
Place a small spoonful of the coconut mixture onto the center of each pastry square.
Fold the pastry in half to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Place the pastry bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a little water and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
